{{Quest infobox | name = Round 5: Fight! | campaign = Eye of the North | region = Far Shiverpeaks | type = Secondary | given by = [[Magni the Bison]] | given at = [[Gunnar's Hold]] | solo = y | repeatable = y | preceded by = [[Round 4: Fight!]] | followed by = [[Final Round: Fight!]] (see notes)
[[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] }} Win round five of [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== *Win the fifth round of the Norn fighting tournament. ===Reward=== :''No quest reward'' *You gain 25 [[Norn Reputation Point]]s for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above) *You gain a quest reward after beating all 6 rounds, see [[Final Round: Fight!]] (first time completion) or [[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] (for repeated victories) ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Magni the Bison :''"'''[Solo Quest]''' If you have made it to the '''fifth round''' of my '''tournament''' alive and unbroken, congratulations. You are nearly the equal of a [[Norn]]! Defeat your next '''opponent''', and you shall earn the honor of facing me! Then you shall know the sour taste of defeat."'' ===Intermediate dialogue=== :(The dialogue depends on which opponent you are facing. See [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for the dialogue and quotes.) ==Notes== *Round five opponents may be [[Argo]], [[Devona]], [[Gwen]], [[Mhenlo]], [[Nika]], or [[Talon Silverwing]]. Please refer to [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for details on their skill sets. *This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 4 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 5 opponent. *The follow-up quest will be [[Final Round: Fight!]] if your character has ''not'' won the Norn Fighting tournament before. On subsequent victories, the follow-up quest will be [[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] instead. [[Category:Rewards Norn reputation points]]
